description: Rejects falsely asserting that indecomposable 2-circulant complex Hadamard matrices (such as Szollosi B_6) factor into a Kronecker tensor product U (x) V to claim Conjecture 2(b) qubit block parity cancellation without evaluating the 2-circulant Laurent monomials.
negative_fixture: Claiming: B_6(theta) = U(phi) (x) V implies alpha_2 = 2m - 3 cancels qubit block.
positive_fixture: For indecomposable 2-circulant H = [[A, B], [B^dagger, -A^dagger]], odd exponent beta_2 = 3(2m - 3) guarantees (-1)^{beta_2} = -1, causing both G_H and G_{H^*} to vanish independently via column Laurent monomial pairing.
